Definition: of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses):--perceive.
BiblicalUsage: Once, at a telling moment: after Jesus speaks of His coming betrayal, the disciples understood not this saying, and they perceived it not. The word is to take something in by the senses — to grasp it, to feel its weight.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse about not perceiving carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the scene, disciples who heard Jesus plainly and were afraid to ask what He meant.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Demon-Possessed Boy
